name: CADCraft v0.6.2
body:
## What's Changed
* AUDIT and RECOVER: find and fix database errors, open damaged drawings repaired (part of #406) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/411
* Plot styles: colour-dependent tables (monochrome, grayscale) apply to PDF plots and layouts (part of #410) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/412
* MTEXT: Height, Justify, Line spacing, Rotation, Style, Width, Columns (part of #408) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/415
* SPLINE: Knots, start/end Tangency, toLerance and Object (part of #408) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/413
* MLEADER: spline and no-leader types, block content (fixes #408) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/419
* Groups: GROUP, UNGROUP and GROUPEDIT; erased members leave their groups (part of #417) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/422
* Plot styles: named styles (STB), PLOTSTYLE, STYLESMANAGER, table files and the Plot Style Manager (part of #410) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/418
* Add shared workspace docking to CADCraft by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/456
* IMPORT, EXPORT, Plot Preview and Batch Publish; ATTACH, SHARE, 3DORBIT say not available yet (part of #9) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/186
* Print opens a Plot dialog (#160) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/200
* Transparent 'ZOOM/'PAN run nested and resume the interrupted command (fixes #220) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/221
* Select objects: W, C, F, WP and CP selection modes (fixes #224) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/226
* Scripts and the command line read a trailing or double space as Enter (fixes #227) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/229
* Right-to-left drawing text: bidi and Arabic-script shaping (Persian, Arabic, Urdu) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/315
* fonts: embed craft-fonts when built with CRAFT_FONTS_DIR by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/321
* Autosave (SAVETIME, SAVEFILEPATH) and Drawing Recovery after a crash (fixes #406) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/416
* Groups: PICKSTYLE group selection, Ctrl+Shift+A and -GROUP options (fixes #417) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/424
* DXF/DWG at a chosen version 2000–2018 and binary DXF (part of #421) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/426
* TOLERANCE: GD&T feature control frames (fixes #420) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/427
* SAVEAS version and binary DXF, default save version (fixes #421) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/431
* SELECTSIMILAR and object isolation: ISOLATEOBJECTS, HIDEOBJECTS, UNISOLATEOBJECTS (part of #428) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/434
* Grips: hot-grip options (Base point/Copy/Undo/Reference/eXit) and multiple hot grips (part of #425) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/435
* Select objects: BOX, AUto, SIngle, Multiple, Group and Undo keywords (fixes #428) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/438
* Grips: multifunctional grip menus for polylines, lines and arcs (fixes #425) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/440
* BATTMAN: edit, remove and reorder attribute definitions; references follow (part of #433) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/444
* Temporary tracking point TT and tracking TK at every point prompt (part of #441) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/445
* Draw order: DRAWORDER Above/Under objects, TEXTTOFRONT, HATCHTOBACK, SORTENTSTABLE read (part of #439) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/446
* DATAEXTRACTION and EATTEXT: block and attribute data to rows, CSV and a table (fixes #433) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/447
* MATCHPROP: source/destination picker and Settings (part of #439) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/449
* PolarSnap, relative polar angles, Extension on ellipse and spline ends, tracking options in Drafting Settings (fixes #441) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/450
* OVERKILL: tolerance, ignored properties, overlapping and end-to-end lines and arcs, polyline segments (fixes #439) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/452
* Hatch: associative hatches follow their boundary objects; DXF 97/330 source objects (part of #451) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/454
* Associative arrays: ASsociative, Levels and polar ROWs (part of #448) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/455
* Hatch: HPGAPTOL, pattern origin, separate hatches, island style; HATCHEDIT options and -HATCHEDIT (fixes #451) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/457
* Viewports: polygonal, object and clipped viewports, VPCLIP, MVIEW ON/OFF/Lock/Restore (part of #453) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/458
* ARRAYEDIT and ARRAYCLOSE for associative arrays (fixes #448) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/460
* Status bar: viewport scale list and lock toggle (fixes #453) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/462
* UNDO Mark/Back, BEgin/End, Auto and Control; MREDO; UNDOCTL (part of #461) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/464
* DXF: native MULTILEADER read and write instead of LEADER + MTEXT (fixes #459) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/465
* SETVAR/GETVAR: header variables the commands keep, TRANSPARENCYDISPLAY, dimension variables in SETVAR ? (fixes #461) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/467
* EXTEND, JOIN and LENGTHEN on elliptical arcs and splines (part of #466) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/469
* FILLET with elliptical arcs and splines (part of #466) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/470
* Annotative scaling: scale list, CANNOSCALE, OBJECTSCALE, ANNOALLVISIBLE (part of #468) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/486
* Annotative scaling: DXF and status bar annotation scale list (fixes #468) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/506
* FILLET and CHAMFER with polyline segments (fixes #466) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/502
* Named views (VIEW), Zoom Realtime and Dynamic, ZOOMFACTOR (part of #463) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/503
* Tiled model viewports: VPORTS, saved viewport configurations, DXF VPORT table (part of #463) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/504
* DXF: reopen-and-save keeps one *D block per dimension and stable handles (fixes #495) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/508
* Web: opt-in embedding bridge for host pages (?host=parent) by @CyberFox-81 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/509
* DXF: read pre-2007 files in their $DWGCODEPAGE (CJK, Cyrillic, Central European…) (fixes #505) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/511
* Dimension styles: fit, text movement, suppressed halves, fixed extension lines, linetypes and lineweights and more DIM variables (part of #507) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/514
* Shortcut menus: command menu while a command runs, selection menu with object edits (part of #512) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/515
* MLINE: multiline entity, MLSTYLE and MLEDIT (part of #510) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/517
* ci: refactor workflows to use storytold/craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/605
* Shortcut menus: command line, drawing and layout tabs, Layers and Properties palettes (fixes #512) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/518
* Dimension text: degrees/minutes/seconds angles round at the displayed precision by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/520
* HELIX: helix entity drawn as a spline (part of #510) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/521
* Dimension edits: DIMEDIT Oblique/New/Rotate/Home, DIMJOGGED, DIMJOGLINE, DIMBREAK, DIMINSPECT (part of #507) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/522
* Dynamic Input options menu (DYNPROMPT), second-value lock; INS on ATTDEF/MLEADER, GCEN on closed splines (part of #519) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/523
* QDIM: Staggered, Baseline, Ordinate, Radius, Diameter, datumPoint and Edit (fixes #507) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/524
* Grip dimensional input: length, angle and radius fields while stretching a grip, DYNDIVIS/DYNDIGRIP (part of #519, stacked on #440) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/527
* Xrefs: XATTACH, -XREF, XBIND, XOPEN; load at open, save only the reference (part of #525) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/530
* Xrefs: External References palette and XREF (fixes #525) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/533
* REGION: region entity, UNION/SUBTRACT/INTERSECT, MASSPROP (fixes #510) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/526
* OPTIONS: preferences dialog, JSON form and a user profile that survives restarts (fixes #23) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/531
* Add Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) interface language by @WladmirJunior in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/539
* DXF: keep what we don't model on save — unknown entities and objects, foreign xdata, extension dictionaries, reactors, colour books (fixes #528) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/545
* feat(text): MTEXT paragraph formatting (indents, tabs, lists) and columns by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/547
* Tables: cell styles, formulas, TABLEDIT and TABLEEXPORT (part of #534) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/548
* Tables: table breaking and CSV data links (fixes #534) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/553
* Constraints: DOF report, G2 Smooth, ellipse/spline/block geometry (part of #546) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/550
* Constraints: CONSTRAINTINFER while drawing and editing, DOF status on the canvas (fixes #546) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/555
* Fix constraint_infer test after associative-array default (#455) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/621
* Support files: user .lin linetypes and .pat hatch patterns (part of #552) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/557
* Support files: DWT templates for NEW/QNEW, SAVEAS .dwt, user alias files (fixes #552) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/562
* feat(modify): PEDIT Edit vertex Break/Straighten/Tangent/Regen, SPLINEDIT fit data and vertex options, closed-spline fit tolerance (part of #554) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/558
* feat(drafting): isometric snap/grid, ISODRAFT, ISOPLANE, ELLIPSE Isocircle by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/561
* feat(inquiry): COUNT across layouts and nested blocks, COUNTLIST, COUNTTABLE (part of #563) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/565
* Plot styles: apply line end, join and fill styles (part of #564) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/566
* DXF: keep full-circle, spline and clockwise ellipse hatch edges (fixes #492, #493, #494) by @tsangiotis in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/549
* PDF export: layers as PDF layers (OCG), several sheets per file, hyperlinks (part of #560) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/567
* PDF export: real text in embedded TrueType subsets (part of #560) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/571
* CLI: cadcraft-cli exits quietly when stdout is closed early by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/568
* feat(ui): QuickCalc palette; CAL points, vector functions, unit conversion (part of #563) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/569
* Plotters: device configurations with paper sizes and printable areas (fixes #564) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/570
* feat(file): COMPARE drawings with overlay and change areas (fixes #563) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/572
* Windows: use FXC by default for DirectX 12 startup by @PedroGuille in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/613
* Fix Measure Distance snapping through layout viewports by @PedroGuille in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/616
* Fix OFFSET distance clicks and source picking by @PedroGuille in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/618
* SETVAR accepts point objects for SNAPBASE, LIMMIN, LIMMAX and INSBASE (#485) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/575
* SETVAR keeps text variables such as CLAYER as text, so a layer named 10 can be selected (#484) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/576
* Dimension Space asks for the base, the dimensions and the spacing instead of failing (#483) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/577
* dimstyle.rename and delete: cover dimensions inside block definitions (#482) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/578
* Properties: changing a block's scale moves and resizes its attributes (#481) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/579
* Properties: reject a malformed lineweight instead of setting 0.25 mm (#480) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/580
* Align Text > Angle asks for the angle instead of failing with a missing-parameter error (#478) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/582
* properties.set rejects a linetype that is not loaded (#476) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/584
* INSERT with explode records one undo step (#475) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/585
* layer.delete: clear the deleted layer from viewport freeze and colour overrides (#474) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/586
* Properties: turn a block reference's attribute text with its Rotation edit (#473) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/587
* Text style rename: update text inside block definitions (#472) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/588
* OFFSET: full ellipse copy goes to the side of the picked point (#501) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/591
* Parameters Manager: keep a pending expression when the window loses focus (#498) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/594
* Command line keyboard input works while the command line is hidden (#497) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/595
* Plot: apply an explicit scale to non-fitted layout plots (#490) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/598
* Include multileader text in its bounds so zoom, window selection and viewports keep the whole text (#488) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/600
* AREA: refuse an open elliptical arc instead of measuring the whole ellipse (#487) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/601
* STYLE typed with no arguments opens the Text Style dialog instead of an error (#535) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/590
* Web: ?cpu selects the CPU canvas instead of installing the GPU canvas (#500) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/592
* Page Setup: report unsupported layout plot areas as not available yet (#491) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/597
* Select: pick pattern hatches on their visible strokes (#489) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/599
* feat(modify): SPLINEDIT Join, Edit vertex Add and Elevate order by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/559
* Persist SNAPUNIT and GRIDUNIT in DXF (fix #607) by @PedroGuille in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/614
* Add German (de) interface language by @arekown in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/573
* Spanish translation  by @PedroGuille in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/610
* Add PTYPE as an alias of the Point Style command (#622) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/645
* Keep inter-word spaces in stroke-font MTEXT (#628) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/644
* Make right palette collapse arrow interactive (fix #617) by @rangoDJ in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/640
* Tool Sets: the gear on a category header opens that category's options by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/620
* fix(io): write DXF CLASS instance counts and preserve current leader style by @The-Great-Nothing in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/635
* Linux: Theme > System follows the desktop's light/dark setting by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/641
* File-format follow-ups: version-gated MULTILEADER and DIMSTYLE groups, kept $DWGCODEPAGE, PURGE multiline styles by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/632
* Hatches: draw the pattern definition stored in the file; scale library patterns in metric drawings by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/643
* Render: level of detail and view clipping for pattern hatches on screen (fixes #544) by @STE1200 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/638
* Fix fatal wgpu buffer overflow; draw MOVE/COPY/ROTATE/SCALE previews and the selection highlight on the GPU by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/642
* Drafting/plot/UI follow-ups: PolarSnap over isometric snap, MVIEW Restore, plot margins, PNG/SVG pens, PE_URL links, OPTIONS settings (part of #626) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/633
* feat: SVG import — read SVG and SVGZ into native entities by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/636
* docs: refresh gaps.md and parity docs for landed features by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/625
* i18n: add Czech (cs) interface language by @Losminek in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/639
* i18n: add Russian, Spanish, French, Portuguese and German interfaces by @pechnikov2026-star in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/624
* Add raw-HID SpaceMouse 2D navigation by @PedroGuille in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/650
* Add regression tests for Plot Preview toolbar button (fixes #442) by @rangoDJ in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/653
* Fix filled text zoom freezes with cached glyph meshes by @PedroGuille in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/651
* GPU errors and device loss: keep running, autosave at once, tell the user by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/652
* Show block insertion XYZ in Properties Inspector by @markmonkey in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/682
* DXF: write kept application data groups as read, not as handle lists by @CaseyKleinman in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/681
* BRICK: draw each vertical joint once by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/664
* AUNITS: degrees/minutes/seconds angles round at the displayed precision by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/672
* File tabs: cut long drawing names short with an ellipsis by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/657
* Prioritize command aliases in autocomplete and display shortcut match by @rangoDJ in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/656
* control server: bound request lines and concurrent connections by @SteamSmith in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/678
* Zoom the canvas by each mouse-wheel notch in the frame it arrives by @SBaksa in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/692
* Cache active viewport highlights per zoom band so zoom and pan stay smooth (#687) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/695
* Deduplicate identical boundary loops to prevent empty hatch fills by @rangoDJ in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/671
* i18n(es): add 219 missing rows, fix mistranslations and terms by @diegozpy in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/680
* SCRIPT command: run .scr files from the command line, menus and JSON (gaps.md E2) by @Lion-1209 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/693
* Build the screen's model-space display list on all cores; read-write locks for glyph caches by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/654
* MIRROR and PASTE previews on the GPU; GPU previews in layouts too by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/655
* Plot dialog: device, plot style table, Window <, and a preview of its settings by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/673
* Hatch: pick the pattern from swatches instead of typing its name (fixes #669) by @aldozar in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/679
* Add Chinese language support to preferences by @mayloglog in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/684
* Performance: reuse nearby snap geometry for tracking acquisition by @cyfung1031 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/698
* Release workflow: pass the Azure signing secrets by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/647
